title: One sickle, many handles
literal_meaning: If there is a sickle, there are eighteen ganda of handles.
meaning_odia: ଦାଆ ଥିଲେ ତାହା ପାଇଁ ଅଠର ଗଣ୍ଡା ବେଣ୍ଟ—ଏହି ତୁଳନାରେ ମୂଳ ଉପକରଣ ଓ ତାହାର ଅନେକ ବେଣ୍ଟକୁ ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ମୂଳ ଜିନିଷ ଥିଲେ ତାହାର ଆନୁଷଙ୍ଗିକ ଅଂଶ ପାଇଁ ଅନେକ ବିକଳ୍ପ ମିଳିପାରେ। ଗଣ୍ଡା ଗଣନା ଏକକଟିକୁ ମୂଳ ରୂପରେ ରଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The sickle is singular in the condition; handles follow in abundance. Our editorial reading puts the central implement before any particular fitting: when the main thing is available, an accessory may have many alternatives. The source’s eighteen ganda is retained as a counting expression, without converting it into a modern total.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A group has secured its main equipment but worries that one minor fitting must be replaced. Someone recalls the sickle and its many handles to keep the difficulty in proportion.
cultural_context: The verse distinguishes the cutting implement from its handle. Its exaggerated plurality gives the handle a different weight from the thing it serves; it does not describe a particular workshop or farming occasion.
